name: Dillo
description:
Dillo is an ultra-fast, minimalist graphical web browser engineered for efficiency and low resource consumption. Built on FLTK, it loads web pages almost instantaneously and functions smoothly on low-end or vintage hardware.

Features:
- Extremely lightweight footprint consuming only a few megabytes of memory
- Fast HTML rendering engine supporting CSS styling and web images
- Integrated privacy features blocking third-party tracking cookies by default
- Tabbed browsing interface with simple navigation and bookmark management
- Written in clean C and C++ with virtually zero external library bloat
